# Unsolved Problems Mega-Atlas (V2.3.0) — Independent Researcher (0thernes)

> Cross-disciplinary, cryptographically audited open-problem atlas cataloging **1,900 strictly deduplicated unsolved, open, and hard problems** across **8 Macro-Pillars × 28 Superdomains × 8 Substrates × 7 Abstraction Layers (`L0–L6`)** wired into **1 biconnected 5,808-edge knowledge graph (`0` articulation points, `0` bridges, `0` dangling links)**, with **72 Pure Lean 4.35.0 formal invariants**, **0thernes CSS, Titan, Gradient, Margin & Epistemic Spectrum metrics**, an **offline 100% MRR@5 Hybrid BM25+PageRank RAG & dual-framed 9-tool MCP server**, and a **Karpathy-style AutoResearch loop (`AQS = 97.99`) + Track B Antihydra `BB(6)` pilot**.
> Author: Alexander Stephen Donahue (Independent Researcher (0thernes), ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`). Dual License: Data CC BY 4.0 / Code MIT.

## Epistemic Boundary (Critical for LLM Consumers)
- **Formally proved (Pure Lean 4.35.0, 72 theorems, 0 sorry, `[propext, Quot.sound]`):** Exact invariants of scoring formulas (`CSS`, `Titan`, `Leverage`, 300-yr antiquity cap), 4-Quadrant & 6-Era partitions, 8×28 taxonomy surjection, finite Handshaking Lemma, cross-partition edge hierarchy, deduplication bound, AutoResearch anti-gaming keep/discard ratchet, and multi-layer Substrate/Layer/Gradient/Margin/Bridge/Apex-Keystone invariants.
- **NOT proved or retired:** Zero open problems are claimed solved (including Track B's finite Antihydra `BB(6)` simulation). All 12 Fall/Nov 2026 AI proof claims (`verification_flag = "ai-claim-under-audit-nov2026"`) remain officially unretired pending independent formal-statement fidelity and peer consensus. Quantitative 1–10 rubric ratings are disclosed solo-human + AI-assisted falsifiable editorial estimates.

## Machine-Readable Data & Schemas
- [Complete JSON Dataset](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas/main/outputs/MegaAtlas_Unsolved_Problems_V2.json): Full payload with metadata, 1,900 problems (48 fields), 5,808 biconnected edges, substrate/layer/margin matrices, Nov 2026 AI audit, registries & benchmarks.
- [Streaming JSONL (1,900 records)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas/main/outputs/MegaAtlas_Unsolved_Problems_V2.jsonl): One JSON object per problem for immediate HuggingFace/LLM/RAG ingestion.
- [Master CSV (1,900 × 48)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas/main/outputs/MegaAtlas_Unsolved_Problems_V2.csv): Tabular dataset with CSS, Titan, graph centralities, substrates, layers, gradients, margins & verification flags.
- [SQLite 3 + FTS5 Database](https://github.com/0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas/raw/main/outputs/MegaAtlas_Unsolved_Problems_V2.sqlite): 10 normalized tables (incl. `substrate_summary`) + Porter-stemmed FTS5 full-text search index.
- [MLCommons Croissant 1.0 Metadata](https://0thernes.github.io/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas/croissant.json): FAIR AI/ML JSON-LD descriptor (48 fields) with exact SHA-256 checksums.
- [W3C RO-Crate 1.1 Metadata](https://0thernes.github.io/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas/ro-crate-metadata.json): Research Object crate graph with ORCID provenance.
- [JSON Schema Draft 2020-12](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas/main/schema/problem.schema.json): Strict 48-field schema validated on all 1,900 records.
